summary:
CRC outreach worklist 'Okafor CRC 2026' (grp-okafor-crc, 5 members) worked per RBC-QM-02.

| Patient | Status | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| pt-0009 Elly Trantow (age 72) | Open gap: FIT ordered (sr-t0005), patient messaged (comm-t0008) | Not excluded. The frailty diagnosis (cond-00189) was entered in error per Dr. Lin (comm-00301), so the 66+ frailty/advanced illness exclusion fails even though she takes donepezil. No hospice, nursing home or colorectal cancer on record. No screening on record. |
| pt-0020 Kelsie Rohan (age 52) | Excluded | Hospice episode eoc-00002 ran 06/16 to 08/21/2026 (finished; she revoked hospice to join a trial, doc-00402). A finished hospice episode in 2026 still excludes. No order, no contact. |
| pt-0022 Tiny Koss (age 52) | Open gap: FIT ordered (sr-t0003), patient messaged (comm-t0006) | Her only FIT (obs-01732) was corrected: collected 12/31/2025, outside 2026. 01/05/2026 was the lab receipt date. No other screening. |
| pt-0024 Delaine MacGyver (age 51) | Open gap: FIT ordered (sr-t0004), patient messaged (comm-t0007) | The 06/2024 sDNA-FIT (obs-01871) was withdrawn as another patient's specimen and is now entered in error (doc-00401). The active 2025 colonoscopy order (sr-00003) is only an order. No screening done. |
| pt-0073 Marisol Quintero (age 58) | Open gap: FIT ordered (sr-t0001), patient messaged (comm-t0002) | The 01/08/2026 FIT (obs-73001) is entered in error. The re-issued report (obs-05001) shows collection on 12/28/2025, outside 2026 (doc-00403). No other screening. |

Each FIT kit order runs 10/23 to 12/31/2026. None of the patients already had an active FIT order. Each outreach message says the kit is on its way, explains how to collect and mail the sample, and asks the patient to tell us about any outside screening.

Corrections that arrived in the queues (inbox-a0001 to a0005) were reviewed before any decision was recorded. They changed three statuses: pt-0009 went from excluded to open gap, and pt-0022 and pt-0024 went from up to date to open gap. Each decision is documented in a chart note citing RBC-QM-02 (doc-t0009 to doc-t0013), and the five inbox items were completed with links to those notes and orders.

Other open inbox items not related to this worklist were left untouched.

For Dr. Okafor: pt-0024 still has the active 2025 colonoscopy referral (sr-00003). You may want to decide whether to keep it or close it.
